planCorrections.issue: Plan self-contradicts on the bridges-to-fcm floor's strand scope. Phase 2 spec (plan line ~208) says: 'humanities Strand-A units must carry >=1 bridges-to-fcm'. The Phase-8 final gate checklist (plan line ~261) says: 'Every Strand-A/B unit carries >=1 bridges-to-fcm edge'. Strand B (bor-sec-15, -17, -19; bor-sec-16/18 already carry the edge) was built to the narrower Phase-2 rule and has no bridges-to-fcm edge, which fails the broader Phase-8 wording verbatim.
files: Aroles & Kupers - Towards an Integral Pedagogy (2022)/bor-sec-15-aroles-kupers-edges.csv
evidence: bor-sec-15 (Aroles & Kupers 2022) cites only Heidegger's The Question Concerning Technology (1977) and Discourse on Thinking (1966) -- Gestell/Gelassenheit, not FCM.
bor-sec-17 (Mertel 2020) cites only Being and Time, Zollikon Seminars, and The Question Concerning Technology -- authenticity/appropriation/technology, not FCM.
bor-sec-19 (Thomson 2001) cites only What Is Metaphysics? (1929 Inaugural Lecture) and Plato's Teaching on Truth -- ontological education, not FCM.

None of the three cites, quotes, or paraphrases FCM (Heidegger's 1929/30 boredom lecture course) anywhere in their edges files. This was flagged during Strand-B construction itself (see phase0-overview.md 'Update -- Strand B execution'), before the Phase-8 wording conflict was noticed.
planCorrections.resolution: Do not fabricate a bridges-to-fcm edge for bor-sec-15/17/19: none of the three sources engages FCM, and inventing the edge would violate the cluster's own no-fabrication / provenance-tagging discipline that every other edge in this cluster follows. Resolving the plan's internal contradiction in favor of the more specific, deliberately-scoped Phase 2 rule (Strand-A only) over the Phase-8 checklist's broader wording, which reads as an unintentional overreach rather than a considered requirement change. bor-sec-16 and bor-sec-18 (the other two Strand-B units) do carry a genuine bridges-to-fcm edge and are unaffected.
planCorrections.residual: The Phase-8 checklist text itself (plan line ~261) still literally reads 'Strand-A/B'; it is not edited, since amending the plan document after the fact would obscure the fact that this is a discovered inconsistency rather than a pre-existing rule. Flagged for GATE G1 sign-off rather than resolved unilaterally.
